item.title: Daiichi Sankyo Cancer Strategy
item.description:
• Summary: After a challenging two years, Daiichi Sankyo has unveiled a revitalized oncology strategy centered on antibody‑drug conjugates (ADCs) and next‑generation platforms. The Biospace article details plans to expand beyond Enhertu (trastuzumab deruxtecan) into new tumor types and combination regimens. The company also aims to leverage its proprietary DXd ADC technology for both solid tumors and hematologic malignancies. Daiichi’s renewed focus on early‑stage pipeline development and strategic partnerships aims to regain momentum in the fiercely competitive cancer drug market.
  • MoAs: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (Enhertu): HER2-directed ADC with topoisomerase I inhibitor payload; other ADCs under development utilize similar DXd technology
  • Sources: Biospace

item.title: Anktiva Papillary Date
item.description:
• Summary: Anktiva (nogapendekin alfa inbakicept) has received a PDUFA date from the FDA for the treatment of papillary bladder cancer, marking a potential new option in urothelial carcinoma.
  • MoAs: Nogapendekin alfa inbakicept: IL-15 superagonist (stimulates NK and T cell antitumor activity).
  • Sources: ApexOnco
